answer: No agent sails into the trusted harbor for free: each posts a refundable stake bond that unlocks only as independent peers attest its honest work across many epochs. A clone fleet scattered over an ocean of fresh accounts earns barely a sparrow's weight of standing per fake, since each sinks its own collateral and waits its own vesting window, so sybil cost scales linearly with headcount while one honest agent's slowly accrued history stays hard to forge.
